patch: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '90000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_gross_wages' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '18000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_federal_withheld' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"wages": "142000"', '"wages": "90000"'), '"federal_tax_withheld": "28400"', '"federal_tax_withheld": "18000"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
applied_sql: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '90000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_gross_wages' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"wages": "142000"', '"wages": "90000"'), '"federal_tax_withheld": "28400"', '"federal_tax_withheld": "18000"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"wages":"142000"', '"wages":"90000"'), '"federal_tax_withheld":"28400"', '"federal_tax_withheld":"18000"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2025)
probe: SELECT tr.id, tr.tax_year, tr.status, td.doc_type, td.data_json FROM tax_returns tr LEFT JOIN tax_documents td ON td.return_id = tr.id AND lower(td.doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' WHERE tr.user_email = :email ORDER BY tr.tax_year DESC

extra_probes_before.sql: SELECT tr.tax_year, tr.status, d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND tr.tax_year = 2025 AND (lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%w2%' OR lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%wage%') ORDER BY d.field_name

extra_probes_after.sql: SELECT tr.tax_year, tr.status, d.field_name, d.field_value FROM tax_data d JOIN tax_returns tr ON tr.id = d.return_id WHERE tr.user_email = :email AND tr.tax_year = 2025 AND (lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%w2%' OR lower(d.field_name) LIKE '%wage%') ORDER BY d.field_name
